subGoals.text: You are an Atmospheric Technician â€” progression step 3 of 4. Engineers own cables and engines; you own gas, distro, and the TEG loops.
Pick up the atmos hardsuit.
Pick up magboots.
Toggle magboots in-hand (Z / Use).
Pick up a gas analyzer.
Click the oxygen canister (scan mixes before you open valves).
Click the practice air vent â€” distro feeds breathable air into rooms.
Click the practice scrubber â€” waste/scrubbers pull bad air back to filtering.
Distro: mixers set O2/N2 ratios; keep pressure safe. Never dump plasma into distro. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a wrench for pumps, filters, and canisters.
Click the gas filter â€” set it to pull waste gases (CO2, plasma, etc.) off the waste loop.
Filter waste into canisters or burn chambers; do not recirculate toxins into distro. Acknowledge when ready.
Click the TEG center.
Click a TEG circulator â€” one hot loop, one cold loop.
TEG: hot and cold loops must not mix; blue circulators face the cold side. Start with a real hot/cold source (burn chamber / space radiator), not frezon day-one. Acknowledge when ready.
Next: Chief Engineer (command the department, set engine priorities). Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the atmos marker.
Atmos tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for CE when ready.
You are the Bartender. You stock the bar, mix drinks, and keep patrons from wrecking the place.
Click the Booze-O-Mat (tutorial vending machine) to open it.
Pick up a drinking glass.
Pick up the cocktail shaker.
Pick up a vodka bottle.
Pick up the orange juice carton.
Mix a Screwdriver (vodka + orange juice) in the shaker â€” shake until the cocktail forms.
Know your exits and keep the shotgun for emergencies only â€” never point it at random patrons.
Walk to the marker behind the bar.
Bartender tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Botanist. Grow plants for food, medicine, and chemistry.
Pick up a packet of wheat seeds.
Click a hydroponics tray while holding seeds to plant them (tutorial trays ripen instantly).
Pick up a bucket for watering.
Harvest wheat from a ready tray (click the tray when it shows produce).
Robust Harvest and chem-chef loops matter later â€” botanists feed Chef and Chemist. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the hydroponics marker.
Botany tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Captain. Lead department heads, protect the nuclear authentication disk, and make hard calls.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up the captain stamp.
Pick up the captain pen.
Pick up the practice nuclear disk (fake â€” for tutorial only).
Pick up a clipboard.
You decide shuttle calls and station-wide emergencies â€” keep the disk secure. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the bridge marker.
Captain tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Cargo Technician. You'll fly the real cargo shuttle from a mini cargo bay to an Automated Trade Station (ATS) and back â€” the same loop used for trade runs.

You start on the cargo shuttle, docked to a practice cargo bay (consoles, crates, ore processor). East of here is a compact ATS with trade pallets. Find the shuttle console (helm) near the pilot seat.
Click the shuttle console to open the helm UI and take piloting control.
Flight keys while piloting: W/A/S/D strafe, Q/E rotate, Space brake. The Nav tab shows your radar; the Dock tab lists ports.
Open the Dock tab on the helm. Select the port docked to the cargo bay and press Undock.
Undock from the cargo bay using the Dock tab.
With the helm open, hold a flight key (W/A/S/D or Q/E) so the thrusters push the shuttle.
Fly east toward the Automated Trade Station (the farther platform with trade pallets). Keep speed low as you approach â€” use Space to brake.
Align a shuttle airlock with an ATS airlock (ports face each other, short range, ~15Â°). Use the Dock tab and press Dock.
Dock successfully to the Automated Trade Station.
Undock from the ATS when you're ready to return.
Fly back west to the cargo bay. Brake early and line up the docks before committing.
Dock successfully back at the cargo bay.
Cargo trade-run tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a CentCom Official. Represent Central Command â€” inspect, deliver directives, and do not play as station crew.
Pick up the CentCom stamp.
Pick up the CentCom pen.
Pick up the CentCom headset.
Pick up a sheet of paper.
Pick up a clipboard.
Walk to the CentCom marker.
CentCom tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Chaplain. Support crew morale, hold services, and keep the chapel.
Pick up the bible.
Keep holding the bible â€” in a real round you use it on others to heal or smite.
Pick up a book from the practice shelf.
Walk to the chapel marker.
Pick up the NanoTrasen Cahors wine bottle.
Chaplain tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Chef. Your job is to cook food for the crew. This practice kitchen has a ChefVend, Dinnerware machine, microwave, and ingredients.
Walk to the glowing marker so you know the layout of your kitchen.
Pick up a kitchen knife (from the counter or Dinnerware vendor) and hold it.
Get an egg from the egg carton or ChefVend and hold it.
Click the Dinnerware or ChefVend machine to open it. Restock from these when you run low.
Pick up a raw meat slab from the counter or freezer.
Pick up a burger bun.
Put the bun and meat into the microwave, then start it. Interact with the microwave when ready.
When cooking finishes, pick up the plain burger and hold it.
Pick up cake batter from the counter (in a real kitchen you mix flour, eggs, sugar, butter, and milk).
Put the batter in the microwave and cook it into a cake.
Hold the finished plain cake.
Chef tutorial complete. Vendors restock your basics â€” type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Chemist. Manufacture medicines and chemicals for Medical.
Pick up a beaker.
Pick up a large beaker.
Click the chem dispenser to open it (dispense Carbon, Oxygen, and Sugar into a beaker).
Mix Inaprovaline (Oxygen + Carbon + Sugar) so a held or stored beaker contains it.
Click the ChemMaster to open it â€” bottle or pill your product for Medical.
Pick up produce (apple) â€” botanists often supply chemistry.
Put the apple in the reagent grinder and interact with the grinder.
Deliver finished meds to doctors â€” label bottles clearly. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the chemistry marker.
Chemist tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Chief Engineer â€” progression step 4 of 4. Direct engineers and atmos; you set engine and repair priorities.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up advanced magboots (CE kit).
Toggle magboots in-hand (Z / Use).
Open the power monitoring computer and check the grid.
Pick up an AME fuel jar â€” AME is backup/emergency power, not the main plan.
Insert fuel and start AME injection (injection â‰¤ 2Ã— cores).
Prefer Singulo/Tesla/TEG for the shift; keep AME as fallback. Acknowledge when ready.
Inspect the practice TEG â€” atmos owns the loops; you own the power call.
Inspect the singularity generator â€” confirm eng has containment and collectors before starting.
Prioritize: hull/power life support first, then engines, then projects. Coordinate atmos on TEG and breaches. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the CE marker.
CE tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Chief Medical Officer. Lead Medical, set priorities, and handle crises.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up a health analyzer.
Pick up the hypospray.
Use the hypospray in-hand (Z / Use) to practice the ready stance.
Obtain a bruise pack.
Heal the practice patient with meds until damage is nearly gone.
Watch the crew monitor and coordinate paramedics â€” you set triage priorities. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the CMO marker.
CMO tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Clown. Entertain the crew â€” keep it funny, not griefy.
Entertain the crew â€” never grief with lethal pranks or sabotage. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up the bike horn.
Use the bike horn in-hand (Z / Use) to HONK.
Pick up the soap.
Pick up a banana peel.
Soap and peels are for bits â€” never lethal traps in medical or engineering. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a crayon (any color).
Walk to the clown marker.
Clown tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Detective. Gather evidence, identify suspects, and support Security.
Pick up the forensic scanner.
Scan the practice evidence (click the suspicious napkin).
Pick up a fingerprint pad.
Fibers and prints hint at departments and suspects â€” log findings for the HoS. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up handcuffs.
Cuff the practice suspect if detention is needed.
Walk to the detective marker.
Detective tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Head of Personnel. Assign jobs, update IDs, and oversee Service.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up the HoP stamp.
Pick up the HoP pen.
Click the ID console to open it.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up a sheet of paper.
Job transfers and access changes go through you â€” stamp paperwork clearly. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the HoP marker.
HoP tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Head of Security. Lead officers, set alerts, and handle major threats.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up the HoS stamp.
Enforce Space Law and lead the department â€” set force policy for officers. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up handcuffs.
Cuff the practice suspect.
Pick up a stun baton.
Interact with the SecTech vending machine.
Walk to the HoS marker.
HoS tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Janitor. Clean spills, replace lights, and keep the station safe underfoot.
Pick up a mop and hold it.
Pick up a bucket.
Pick up the galoshes (hold them â€” do not just equip yet).
Wet the mop (bucket/water tank) and mop up the blood puddle until it is gone.
Empty dirty water at the floor drain (click the drain).
Pick up the space cleaner spray.
Never mix space cleaner with potassium â€” it can explode. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a trash bag for litter runs.
Walk to the cleaning marker.
Janitor tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Medical Doctor. Diagnose damage, apply medicine, and stabilize patients.
Pick up the health analyzer.
Interact with the NanoMed / medical vending machine.
Obtain a bruise pack (from the floor or vend).
Obtain ointment.
Apply bruise packs and ointment to the practice patient until damage is nearly gone.
Critical patients need epi/inaprov and often a stasis bed â€” do not drag them forever. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the medical marker.
Doctor tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Mime. Entertain through silence and gesture.
Vow of silence: do not speak over radio or local chat while playing Mime. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a pen â€” mimes write when they cannot speak.
Invisible wall is a mime signature â€” use it for bits, not griefing hallways. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up the mime crayon.
Pick up a sheet of paper.
Silently walk to the mime marker.
Mime tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Paramedic. Reach patients fast, stabilize them, and bring them to Medical.
Pick up a folded roller bed.
Pick up an epinephrine bottle.
Pick up gauze.
Stabilize the critical practice patient (bruise packs/ointment/epi) until damage drops.
Walk the patient path to the medical marker (drag or rollerbed on a real shift).
Dead crew go in body bags for the morgue â€” do not leave corpses in hallways. Acknowledge when ready.
Paramedics often have externals access for hull breaches and EVA recoveries. Acknowledge when ready.
Paramedic tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.

This is the combined Passenger / Assistant tutorial. It teaches general station mechanics: moving, picking up items, inventory, drinking, and crowbarring unpowered doors. Finish this before specializing into other jobs.
Walk to the glowing tutorial marker across the practice room.
Click the crowbar on the table to pick it up. Held items show in your hands.
Pick up a flashlight and hold it.
Put the flashlight into your backpack, satchel, or a pocket (open inventory / click a storage slot). It must leave your hands.
Take a flashlight back out into your hand.
Activate the flashlight in-hand (Z / Use) to toggle it on or off.
Pick up a water bottle.
Use the water bottle in-hand (Z / Use) to open and drink. You may need to use it twice if it starts closed.
Hold a crowbar again.
With the crowbar in hand, click the maintenance airlock in the east wall to pry it open (works on many unpowered doors).
Basics complete. You know movement, pickup, inventory, drinking, and crowbarring. Type /ghost and respawn to try a job tutorial.
You are the Quartermaster. Lead Cargo, manage the budget, and keep techs organized.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up the appraisal tool.
Use the appraisal tool in-hand (Z / Use) â€” on a real shift, appraise sellable crates.
Click the cargo order console to open it.
Prioritize head and critical department orders before fluff. Acknowledge when ready.
Cargo Technicians fly the trade shuttle â€” point them at the Cargo Tech tutorial for piloting. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a bounty manifest.
Walk to the QM marker.
QM tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are the Research Director. Set research priorities and keep the lab safe â€” including anomaly containment.
Pick up the command headset.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up an anomaly scanner.
Next room has a containment pad, C.H.I.M.P., and A.P.E. This practice anomaly never reshuffles â€” containment is always Zeta.
Activate the anomaly containment pad to spawn the practice anomaly.
Hold an anomaly scanner and use it on the practice anomaly until the scan finishes.
Pick up the C.H.I.M.P. handcannon (or use the A.P.E.). Switch fire mode to Zeta if needed.
Fire Zeta particles until the anomaly is no longer Growing.
Keep applying containment until the anomaly decays and disappears.
Set research priorities and keep scientists safe â€” you own lab crises. Acknowledge when ready.
Interact with the YouTool vending machine.
Walk to the RD marker.
RD tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Salvage Specialist. Mine wrecks, haul ore, and survive space.
Pick up magboots.
Toggle magboots in-hand (Z / Use) before lattice walks.
Pick up a proto-kinetic accelerator.
Pick up a pickaxe.
Pick up an ore bag.
Walk across the lattice chamber to the salvage marker.
Pick up a sample of steel ore.
Magnets and expeditions are run with Cargo â€” Cargo Techs pilot the shuttle. Acknowledge when ready.
Salvage tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Scientist. Research technologies, study anomalies, and support robotics. This tutorial includes a full practice anomaly: spawn, scan, stabilize, and remove.
Pick up an anomaly scanner.
Pick up a node scanner.
Pick up a beaker.
Next room has a containment pad, a C.H.I.M.P. handcannon, and an A.P.E. This practice anomaly never reshuffles particles â€” containment is always Zeta.
Activate the anomaly containment pad to spawn the practice anomaly.
Hold an anomaly scanner and use it on the practice anomaly (hold click until the scan finishes). Read the particle roles on the scanner UI.
Containment particles weaken the anomaly (health + stability). On this practice anomaly, containment is always Zeta. Danger is Delta; unstable is Epsilon; transformation is Sigma.
Pick up the C.H.I.M.P. handcannon (or use the A.P.E.). Switch its fire mode to Zeta if it is not already.
Fire Zeta particles at the anomaly until the scanner shows it is no longer Growing (stability drops into a stable/decaying band).
Keep applying Zeta / containment until the anomaly decays and disappears (safe removal â€” do not push it supercritical with Delta).
Interact with the YouTool vending machine.
Pick up a multitool.
Walk to the science marker.
Scientist tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Security Officer. Keep the peace, detain suspects, and follow space law.
Pick up a stun baton.
Pick up a disabler.
Pick up a flash.
Toggle the seclite in-hand (Z / Use).
Pick up handcuffs.
Cuff the practice suspect (click them with handcuffs).
Interact with the SecTech vending machine.
The Warden sets brig times; use proportional force. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the security marker.
Security tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
You are a Station Engineer â€” progression step 2 of 4. You should already know door wires, plating, and LV from Technical Assistant.
Pick up meson scanners (eye protection for welding and engines).
Pick up MV cable.
Place MV cable on the floor (explosions and tesla often cut MV runs to substations).
Click the practice substation â€” it steps HV/MV down toward APCs.
Pick up HV cable.
Place HV cable on the floor (engine output and SMES live on HV).
Click the empty SMES â€” on a real shift you finish construction (wrench, cable, screwdriver) then charge it.
SMES banks buffer engine power. Keep at least one charged for blackouts. Acknowledge when ready.
Open the power monitoring computer.
Use the monitor to spot dead APCs and cut cable runs after explosions. Acknowledge when ready.
Click the singularity generator.
Singulo needs a containment field, PA emitters aimed at the generator, and radiation collectors with plasma tanks. Do not walk the PA beam. Acknowledge when ready.
Click the tesla generator.
Tesla needs containment and coils/grounding rods; loose bolts jump to machines and people. Acknowledge when ready.
Next: Atmospheric Technician (distro, TEG, waste filters). Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the engineering marker.
Engineer tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for Atmos or CE when ready.
You are a Technical Assistant â€” engineering progression step 1 of 4. Learn doors, hull patches, and LV wiring before Station Engineer.
Pick up a screwdriver.
Use the screwdriver on the practice airlock until its wires panel opens.
Pick up a multitool (used on open wire panels).
On a real door: pulse/cut the bolt wire to drop bolts; cutting power kills the door. Do not grief. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up a stack of steel sheets.
Click the hull-breach marker while holding steel (on a real shift, cover lattice with plating).
Seal breaches before they spread â€” plating on lattice, then restore atmos if needed. Acknowledge when ready.
Pick up LV cable (CableApcStack). Explosions often cut these under APCs.
Place LV cable on the floor (click plating while holding the coil) until a cable appears.
Click the practice APC â€” on a real station, LV from the substation feeds the APC.
Next: Station Engineer (substations, SMES, Singulo/Tesla, MV/HV). Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the technical assistant marker.
Technical Assistant tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for Station Engineer when ready.
You are practicing as a Traitor. Open your Character menu to see example objectives. Nothing here is a real round â€” experiment safely.
Review the placeholder objectives in your Character menu. They show what kill, steal, and escape goals look like.
Pick up the handheld radio. Traitors often need quiet coordination.
Pick up the cryptographic sequencer (emag). In a real round this opens many secured things.
Hold the syndicate headset. Channel access is a core traitor tool.
Pick up the syndicate encryption key.
Walk to the marked practice spot.
Traitor tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn to try another role.
You are the Warden. Run the brig, manage timers, and secure the armory.
Pick up the warden stamp.
Pick up a clipboard.
Pick up handcuffs.
Cuff the practice prisoner (click them with handcuffs).
Click the brig timer to open it.
Click the practice gun safe / armory locker.
Armory gear is handed out with discipline â€” track who has what. Acknowledge when ready.
Walk to the warden marker.
Warden tutorial complete. Type /ghost and respawn for another role.
